info.description: One execution of a campaign. Holds the Rutba-MTA batch_uuid and mirrors that batch's counters, so a run stays readable even if the MTA is unreachable. Engine-written — no create/update descriptors.

batch_uuid.description: Rutba-MTA batch id. One per submitted chunk group; the report poller reads GET /v1/batches/:uuid/report.

is_test.description: Test sends produce a run so they are auditable, but never advance the campaign schedule.

suppressed.description: Dropped by the MTA suppression gate before queueing.

opened.description: Unique recipients who opened (local tracking pixel — Phase 4 option (b)).

clicked.description: Unique recipients who clicked any tracked link. actions_clicked covers MTA action-token clicks separately.

tracked_links.description: Ordered destination URLs behind /cmp/t/c/<token>/<index>. Server-side lookup by index is what rules out open redirects.

actions_clicked.description: Per-action click counts from the MTA batch report, e.g. { accept_url: 43 }.
